results.name: Harmony Day Spa
results.notes: Re-checked directly. Birdeye mirror (opened) shows 15 W Prospect St #1, 5.0 from 17 reviews, daily 9:30 a.m.-8:00 p.m., and 'this profile has not been claimed'. BestProsInTown (opened) describes a single attentive therapist in a medical building working on neck/shoulder/lower back. Google Maps searches reproduce the record's negatives: name+town search returns other spas plus an unrelated 'Harmony Day Spa' at 100 Tulip Dr with no reviews, and the phone search for 732-518-8352 returns 'Google Maps can't find'. Building page for 15 W Prospect St lists only a couple of health tenants in the limited view. No site found; harmonydayspa.com belongs to the Caldwell namesake as the record says. Minor: the 'hot-stone work' detail in what_they_do was not visible in the sources I opened. Status 'operating' rests on directory pages only (no live GBP found), so treat current trading as likely but unverified. Scores reasonable: gap 5 (nothing findable), pay 2 (solo therapist), ease 4, evidence 2 (two directories corroborate the business but no first-party or Google source).

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The business has a live Google Business Profile named 'Curb Appeal NJ' (5.0, 'Gutter cleaning service', open, phone (732) 510-0377) whose website field points to curbappealnj.com; the Yahoo profile lists the same domain. So it is not directory-only and a website is attached.
Yahoo shows 5.0 from 7 reviews (Yelp-sourced, latest 03/28/26) and Google shows 5.0; both are visible on the pages cited in the record.

wrong_claims.claim: 'No booking or quote path' and no web presence to assess
wrong_claims.what_is_true: There IS a quote path: the Yahoo profile has a 'Request a Quote' link and the linked site has a quote form with name/phone/email/service checkboxes/message/photo upload. The complication is that curbappealnj.com currently serves a different-looking business - 'CURB APPEAL LLC', residential hardscaping and masonry, Parsippany-Troy Hills & Springfield, phone (908) 723-3668, email Curbappealllcnj@gmail.com - with no mention of gutters, windows, solar or snow. Either the domain was reassigned or the business has pivoted; either way the GBP's website link no longer matches the gutter/exterior-maintenance listing.

results.notes: Also corrected context: the Yahoo profile places the business in Fords, NJ 08863, not East Brunswick (it appears in East Brunswick's gutter category); trade name on Yahoo is 'Curb Appeal'. Reviews name 'John' and 'Andrew' doing gutters/power washing. Status confirmed operating (reviews through March 2026, profile open, hours 7:30-6:30). Gap cut from 5 to 3 because a claimed, reviewed GBP and a connected website exist; the real gap is the website/GBP identity mismatch and no online booking. Ease 4 -> 3 because untangling the domain and service mix is not a quick build. Evidence 2 -> 4: GBP, Yahoo/Yelp reviews and the site itself were all read directly.
